neighbours.label: ' more' or ' further' right after a capitalized sentence-initial 'For' (For more information, For further details)
fire:
Call our office today.
For more details, write to Anna at the desk.
The clinic opens in May. For further details see our website.
Most patients recover fast. For more serious injuries, surgery helps.
He sold paintings. For more than twenty years, he lived in Rome.
Tickets are on sale now. For more info, call the box office.

The trail is short.
For more experienced hikers, try the ridge.
Rates are listed below. For further questions, email the bank.
She taught piano. For more than a decade, her school thrived.
quiet:
Call our office today.
I want more details about the desk.
The clinic opens in May. We paid for more staff this year.
Most patients recover fast. Some need more serious surgery.
He sold paintings. He lived in Rome for more than twenty years.
Tickets are on sale now. More info is at the box office.

The trail is short.
These hikers asked for more water.
Rates are listed below. Further questions go to the bank.
She taught piano. Her school thrived for more than a decade.

notes: Three different sentences scored the identical 0.430 in the probes because the pole peaks at the second token, before the rest of the sentence matters. So near misses vary the lead-in.
